findings.summary: The observed value did not match the test's expectation.

suggestions.text: Compare the expected and received values with the setup steps and product requirements. Correct the assertion only if its expectation is wrong; otherwise investigate the application state.

evidence.text: Error: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed Locator: locator('.todo-count') Expected: "2 items left" Received: "1 item left" Timeout: 1500ms Call log: - Expect "toHaveText" locator('.todo-count') with timeout 1500ms - waiting for locator('.todo-count') 15 × locator resolved to … - unexpected value "1 item left"

limitations: Diagnoses describe recorded symptoms; a single trace does not establish root cause or flakiness.
No failure observed does not prove the test passed. Library-only traces can omit assertions and test-level errors.
The lab-trained classifier is not used for external traces. Suggestions require human review and never edit source files.
URLs in network context omit credentials, queries and fragments; error messages and source paths may still contain private data.
Playwright trace metadata is an internal format; missing or unsupported records can limit this report.
